notes.title: Early Access - Week 52
notes.notes:
Hello!

I just wanted to clarify that the relative lack of updates recently should not be taken as a sign that the game is no longer being worked on! On the contrary, I have been working on something much bigger and more complex than previous updates, which is therefore taking a lot longer to complete: an interior view with a fully 3D modeled cockpit, with working instruments and displays! Below, you can find a work-in-progress preview of the model:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/01a196b98e854661d7c886ffdec9c56f7ccdf604.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access - Week 40
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/26847114e24146a378608b42ec27690fa759f923.png[/img]

Hello!

This week, we have a complete revamp of the game's difficulty progression, mostly concerning the Hard and Ace difficulties.

The Ace difficulty is now solely dedicated to tracks that require super-maneuverability/thrust vectoring. All the tracks from Ace that did not require it were moved to Hard, and all the tracks from Hard that required it were moved to Ace.

Since super-maneuverability is so different to normal flight and unintuitive at first, even to experienced pilots, it seemed to make sense to isolate it on its own difficulty, since it probably represents a bigger leap in difficulty than anything else.

Furthermore, all the game's tracks have been reordered to what is hopefully a more sensible difficulty progression.

notes.title: Early Access - Week 35
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/e5f665b01057506b61ffd33dfae39f5042619b24.png[/img]

Hello!

We are finally back with more updates! For week 35 of Early Access, we have a new feature:

- Photo Mode: Pause the game at any time during gameplay or replays and open Photo Mode! It allows you to freely move the camera, adjust the field of view and save pictures from the game to your computer as .png files.

Please note that Photo Mode utilizes its own controls. Due to the way the game saves your control settings, all the Photo Mode controls will be unassigned if you have played the game before and saved your control settings. Please assign them on your own or simply use the button "Restore Defaults" on the Controls Settings screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/4d16ba5b7696c4a71f941be38c7cc1f3292a643f.png[/img]

Hello!

For week 20 of Early Access, we have a few misc additions and fixes:

Additions
- Added 4k resolution textures for the planes.
- Added normal mapping to the planes.
- Made available option to toggle between vertical and horizontal splitscreen for multiplayer. Thanks to Voltaic Backlash for suggesting this.

Fixes/Changes
- Fixed glitch that caused Leaderboard buttons to stop working.
- Fixed looping of the song in Medium tracks. Thanks to Voltaic Backlash for reporting this.
- Rebalanced Gold Medal times for tracks up to the Hard Tutorials according to leaderboard data due to feedback that they were too frustrating.

Hello!

For week 19 of Early Access, we have a few misc additions and fixes:

- Allow player to assign the same button/axis to different actions in the control settings. This was necessary to allow assigning the same input for throttle/brake on Combined and Separate mode (if wanted). Thanks to Voltaic Backlash for reporting this.

- Added preliminary tracking camera. Tracks the next checkpoint in a race or the enemy plane in Combat multiplayer mode. Thanks to FasterThanRaito for suggesting it.

For week 2 of Early Access, we have three new tracks:

Carrier Landing Pattern (Medium): On this track, you'll have to simulate landing on an aircraft carrier using the same flight pattern used by the United States Navy.

Kulbit to Carrier (Hard): On this track, you'll have to simulate landing on an aircraft carrier right after performing a Kulbit maneuver, which is most definitely not the flight pattern used by any navy in the world.

Twist and Shoot (Hard): A variation of the Straight Line track which adds targets after every checkpoint, testing your fine control of the plane even further.

As always, these tracks should appear as normal on the track select screen as soon as the game is updated.
